She is speaking directly to the camera in a selfie perspective, gesturing with her hand near her mouth as if sharing a secret. Behind her, shelves are filled with various goods, and other shoppers are visible in the background. (2) The camera moves to a close-up of a wooden display stand featuring colorful condom packaging labeled 'Enjoy Our Nature'. The woman's hand points to three different designs: one with a red volcanic eruption, one with a blue water geyser, and one with a steaming geothermal pool. (3) The shot focuses on a price tag showing '990 Kr' and then moves to a green-themed package featuring the Northern Lights. The woman holds this package up to the camera, showcasing its teardrop shape and the artistic landscape graphic. (4) The scene cuts to show two other women; one in a blue jacket and another in a yellow beanie. They are laughing and looking at the items. The setting remains the indoor shop with wooden walls and ceiling. (5) The main woman is back on screen, standing in front of a large white stuffed polar bear. She holds three of the condom packages fanned out in her hand, gesturing with her other hand while continuing her energetic address to the camera.
